name: IGRM Global Event and Episode Ledger contract
purpose: Separate aggregate source rows, deduplicated source events, canonical geopolitical events and detector-defined salience episodes so that no one number can silently stand in for all four.

frame.geographic_subject: Rows in the GDELT Events v1 daily exports that involve India as an actor or action geography; global export-row counts are retained only as a coverage denominator.
frame.time_end_policy: Latest date present identically in the national, India-partner dyad and Indian-state aggregate stores.
frame.calendar_partition: Every UTC calendar day from time_start through time_end must be either observed in all three aggregate stores or listed once in the legacy unavailable-day register. The legacy register has no retrieval receipts and must not be described as verified provider unavailability.
frame.country_area_frame: Every member of docs/geo/world.json is a display-geometry member. India is not_applicable_self for an India-partner dyad; provider codes outside the geometry are unmappable; absence from the mapped projection has unresolved reason and is not an analytical coverage failure.
frame.source_frame: GDELT Events v1 daily export files. The current store retains aggregates, not raw rows or GlobalEventID values.
frame.rights_boundary: No source-derived count, episode, geometry denominator or historical series may be newly emitted by docs/data/event_ledger.json or rendered by docs/ledger.html until the signed source-rights registry authorizes cite_metadata and publish_derived_value for every required source.
frame.legacy_endpoint_boundary: This gate neither licenses nor retracts pre-existing source-specific endpoints such as episodes.json, map_relations.json or world_state.json. Their separate rights decisions remain review_required; readers must not infer that the Event Ledger refusal authorizes them.

candidate_baseline.successor_rule: Every candidate must retain every UTC day observed in the pinned baseline daily store. A blocked publication interval cannot reset this floor.

count_units.definition: Counts of valid-layout rows in a named GDELT daily export after the published India-involvement filter, plus the valid-layout row denominator. Malformed rows rejected before parsing are not counted. Rows are not deduplicated by stable event identity.
Distinct upstream events after stable-ID deduplication and revision handling.
count_units.unavailable_reason: The current aggregate store does not retain GlobalEventID or raw-row revision lineage.

count_units.definition: Cross-source resolved, typed and versioned geopolitical event objects that pass the canonical-release rights, method and signature gates.
count_units.unavailable_reason: No production canonical event release has been issued; source rights, method and release-signer registries remain fail-closed.

count_units.definition: Threshold-defined windows in the five IGRM press-salience channels. An episode is a detector output, not a unique geopolitical event or an event census.

episode_rules.membership: Use the committed detector output exactly; do not merge overlapping channel windows or reinterpret them as one real-world event.
episode_rules.boundary: Start, end and peak date are inclusive ISO dates; peak must lie inside the window and n_spike_days cannot exceed calendar window length.
episode_rules.revision: A changed detector window changes the release digest. Historical revisions require a later dated release; this first public event-ledger artifact does not claim a pre-existing revision history.
episode_rules.lifecycle: Detector windows are provisional_open_window until the press-salience detector has observed the full three-day clustering gap after their last spike; only then are they detector_window_closed. Neither state is an allegation, confirmation, disruption or recovery state.

requirements: Stable source identifiers and raw evidence lineage
Cross-source resolution with declared independence groups
Role-eligible evidence for every lifecycle transition
Registered executable methods or signed manual decisions
Point-in-time revision log and correction blast-radius graph

public_release_gate.unsigned_behavior: Publish a value-free refusal artifact; never publish candidate counts.
public_release_gate.trust_root_change_authority: A human-reviewed code change must pin the signer ID and exact Ed25519 public key before any signed decision can authorize this endpoint. An agent-created key or role string never establishes trust.

historical_series_policy.permitted_claim: After rights approval, a user may inspect the historical aggregate row series included in the current release and the release-bound detector episode set.
historical_series_policy.prohibited_claim: A date-indexed backfill is not point-in-time knowledge replay. Only immutable predecessor-bound public vintages may support release-as-known-at replay.
historical_series_policy.future_release_rule: Each authorized release must be stored immutably, bind its predecessor release-state digest and publish a typed date and episode delta. A previously observed day may never be laundered into unavailable.
historical_series_policy.archive_append_rule: Every committed predecessor vintage must remain byte-identical and present; only the next sequential vintage may be added. The current worktree must match every committed vintage, and the full typed delta must recompute from its predecessor.
historical_series_policy.release_time_rule: released_at must be UTC to the second, cannot precede any bound evidence or knowledge date, must increase strictly across vintages and cannot exceed the verifier wall clock by more than five minutes.

prohibited_interpretations: A count of unique geopolitical events
A world risk, severity or probability score
A claim that missing countries or days have zero events
A like-for-like longitudinal comparison of raw row levels across unregistered provider corpus regimes
